messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: tenant-token-spike • Tenant: orion-prod (dedicated-vpc) • Severity: P2 

samir.khan: oncall here, grabbing it. seeing a sustained token-per-request jump from orion-prod on the dedicated pool. Per-tenant throttles firing and customers reporting bill spikes.

lina.wu: Lina (CS) - Orion reporting automated billing alerts. They're high-priority customer; told them we're investigating and to pause traffic if possible.

miguel.ramos: initial quick look: request payloads look similar but token accounting on our side is dramatically higher for the new client build. Example: same text yields 20 tokens expected -> 240 tokens observed server-side.

orion_oncall: we rolled a client microchange ~8m ago to add a preprocessing step for emoji normalization. We didn't expect an increase this large. Please advise asap.

samir.khan: first goals: 1) stop further billing/limit damage, 2) isolate tenant so no noisy neighbor, 3) produce quick short note to Orion. Runbooks referenced: #incidents/tokenizer-issues.

miguel.ramos: hypothesis: client-side preprocessor is inserting combining sequences / extra ZWJ bytes that our tokenizer treats as separate graphemes. Also possible encoding mismatch (UTF-16 vs UTF-8) at their SDK boundary. grabbing payload example.

miguel.ramos: raw payload we captured:
```
{"message":"患者さん: \ud83d\udc69\u200d\ud83d\udcbb welcome — emoji cluster test: \ud83e\udd23\ud83d\ude02"}
```

miguel.ramos: token counts:
- Redwood-standard tokenization (server): 22 tokens
- observed server accounting for this request: 236 tokens
- local repro if I feed client-processed bytes: 230 tokens

samir.khan: I'm applying a temporary tenant hard cap and routing them to an isolated fallback pool. Also enabling per-tenant input-normalize flag (opt-in) so we can correct encoding before tokenization.

samir.khan: commands issued:
```
redwoodctl tenants set orion-prod --tokens-per-minute 50000  # from 10k
redwoodctl tenants set orion-prod --input-normalize true
redwoodctl routing assign orion-prod --pool dedicated-isolate-02
```

ops_bot: ACTION: tokens_per_minute changed for orion-prod -> 50000 by samir.khan
ops_bot: ACTION: input-normalize enabled for orion-prod by samir.khan
ops_bot: ACTION: routing update applied for orion-prod -> dedicated-isolate-02

lina.wu: Orion says throttles dropped immediately after you changed the cap and route. They're asking for a billing pause and reversal for the burst window (08:22-08:40).

miguel.ramos: digging deeper: their SDK switched from our recommended tiny-tokenizer (which normalizes grapheme clusters) to a community tokenizer that expands ZWJ sequences into separate codepoints. Also found their SDK was sending UTF-16 code units in a payload declared as UTF-8 in a rare edge-case when the payload contained surrogate pairs. Combines to large token explosion.

miguel.ramos: quick repro snippet I used locally (node):
```
// simulate their preprocessor output vs expected
const clientBytes = Buffer.from('\ud83d\udc69\u200d\ud83d\udcbb','utf16le'); // bad encoding path
console.log(redwoodTokenizer.count(clientBytes)); // -> 230
console.log(redwoodTokenizer.count(Buffer.from('👩\u200d💻','utf8'))); // -> 14
```

samir.khan: mitigation summary (applied):
- isolated routing to dedicated-isolate-02 to protect other tenants
- raised temporary tokens_per_minute to allow customer traffic while they rollback
- enabled per-tenant input-normalize that forces NFKC and collapses known-expansion ZWJ sequences
- flagged billing_hold for that tenant for the burst window

lina.wu: filed billing_hold internally and told Orion we'll issue credits for the anomaly period. Drafting customer note with root cause and ask: rollback their SDK change + resend a few sample requests for verification.

miguel.ramos: pushed a small canary normalization patch to gateway and enabled it for 5% of orion-prod traffic. Initial metrics: token counts on canary aligned with expected values, CPU impact minimal. Rolling to 100% in 20m if green.

samir.khan: switching oncall to miguel for mitigation and follow-up. @miguel.ramos primary now, @samir.khan backup.

orion_oncall: we rolled back the SDK and will run tests. Please confirm when credits show and when we can safely roll forward.

lina.wu: will follow up on credits. propose: full refund for 08:22-08:40 plus waiving one incident credit. Ok with ops?

miguel.ramos: ok. post-incident items:
- add a pre-ingest encoding sanity check and metric for UTF-16/invalid UTF-8 bytes
- add onboarding note warning about third-party tokenizer libs and ZWJ pitfalls
- add alert for sudden tokens-per-request > 5x baseline per-tenant
- console toggle for "auto-normalize" at tenant level (opt-in for customers)

ops_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated • status: recovery in progress • duration so far ~38m

lina.wu: sent customer-facing note and billing hold confirmation. attaching link to rollback steps and a runbook snippet.

miguel.ramos: creating RFC for the auto-normalize toggle + test vectors (emoji/CJK/ZWJ). Will include sanitized failing payloads. ETA for RFC: 48h.

samir.khan: handoff complete. miguel will own postmortem + customer RCA. I'll return to rotation.

orion_oncall: thanks all, appreciate the quick response. We'll retest and ping logs if we see anything else.

-- end of thread --
